title: Senior Payroll Tax Analyst
description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

This position is responsible for the administration of federal, state, local, employee and employer payroll taxes, including research, analysis, data set-up, reconciliations, and preparation of tax documents/returns in a timely and accurate manner.

Key Responsibilities:

• Prepares and reconciles tax returns and other payroll tax documents. Balances weekly, quarterly, and annual interface files used to report employee/employer wages and taxes to federal, state and local jurisdictions. Also balances W-2s and prepares W-2Cs as needed.

• Reviews audit reports, conducts analysis, and handles inquiries related to taxable wages and taxes. Incumbent will be responsible for complete problem resolution including workflow analysis and implementing process changes to enusre proper controls are established and compliance with SOX requirements.

• Conducts fact finding, as necessary, in support of tax and accounting-related projects to enusres that liabilities, expenses and payments for payroll taxes are properly posted to G/L, and new earnings codes are taxed/reported properly.

• Works closely with tax filing vendor to ensure tasks are done in a timely and accurate manner: 1) taxes filed/remitted, 2) inquiries/audits from federal/state/local jurisdictions researched/resolved, 3) new/changing requirements communicated and implemented, 4) invoices balanced and paid/disputed.

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

• Typically reports to Payroll Manager

• No direct responsibility for supervising others.

Travel Requirements:

• Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

Physical Requirements:

• Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:

• Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Must be eighteen years of age or older.

• Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Knowledge of ADP Smart Compliance

Minimum Education:

• The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.

Preferred Education:

• No additional education

Minimum Years of Work Experience:

• 5

Preferred Years of Work Experience:

• No additional years of experience

Minimum Leadership Experience:

• None

Preferred Leadership Experience:

• None

Certifications:

• None

Competencies:

• Payroll tax filing and reconciliation experience required

• Strong analytical skills requiring procees and data analysis

• Strong quantitative skills utilizing statistics and complex formulas

• Strong computer skills (I.e. Xcel, Access, Word, mainframe applications)

• Strong oral and written communication skills

title: Principal, Talent & Leadership Development
description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines.  Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on talent leader to build a culture that raises the bar on talent: where leaders know what great looks like, how to spot it, and how to grow it.
This person will build talent and leadership programs largely from the ground up using industry-leading practices, lead how we attract, identify, develop and promote high-potential talent, and evaluate, select, and bring in AI-driven talent practices, including predictive talent forecasting, for better and faster talent decisions. This role is about knowing the AI talent-tech landscape deeply and choosing and deploying the right platforms, whether vendor or in-house, not building AI models or algorithms from scratch.
This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. Impact comes through influence rather than authority: partnering with HR business partners and business leaders, earning credibility with senior executives, and using evidence and expertise to drive adoption of talent practices across the organization.
This work is as much about organizational design and change management as it is about building programs: getting the structure, roles, and processes right, and then leading the change management needed for leaders across the organization to adopt and sustain new ways of working.
We are a U.S.-based company operating globally, with colleagues across 10 countries. Programs need to work well beyond the U.S., which means designing with cultural differences in mind from the start and planning for translation and localization of content, not treating them as an afterthought.

Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway! We value diverse candidates and encourage applications, even if you don't perfectly match the job description. Studies have shown that some strong candidates may self-select out of the interview process prematurely, at Smarsh we encourage an inclusive, high-performing environment.

About our culture

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

title: Product Design Manager
description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We are hiring a design lead: a player-coach for someone who still loves to design while also having a passion to make other designers better.

This role sit within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

As a player-coach, you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick. You'll grow and coach the team, raise the craft, and build the practices that let design scale with the company.

This role is remote, with occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

• Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.

• Evolve our design competencies into a standard the whole company can understand and then make it operate. Today that bar largely lives in people's heads. Making it explicit, defensible, and consistently applied.

• Support career growth by running development conversations, writing performance reviews with business-unit leaders, and making the path from one level to the next clear

• Take on real design work yourself. Everything from hard problems, quick wins, exploratory concepts, and the things that unblock the team.

• Partner with leadership to align design direction with product strategy and company goals.

• Build and strengthen design systems that enable consistency, quality, and scalability. This includes raising the team's leverage with AI by helping to drive forward efforts to make our design system agentic-friendly so prototypes can be built from real components.

• Shape design practices across discovery, concept development, interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.

• Encourage exploration and push the team to rethink assumptions while staying grounded in user needs and market realities.

• Advocate for the customer experience across every surface and ensure design decisions always reflect real customer needs.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of product design experience with 2+ years of management experience

• Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support senior designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence

• Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user centered craft.

• Experience building and scaling design systems.

• AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.

• Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
We’re always interested in connecting with experienced Customer Support Engineers who could be a great fit for our team as Verge.io continues to grow.

As a Customer Support Engineer at Verge.io , you’ll work directly with customers to help them deploy, operate, and get the most out of VergeOS, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues and guiding implementations and migrations along the way. It's a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys solving hard problems and working directly with people.

You’ll also help turn what you learn into better documentation and repeatable processes, using AI as a practical tool to research issues, analyze logs, and find better ways to solve recurring problems.

The Role

You’ll work directly with customers throughout their experience with VergeOS, from implementation and migration through ongoing support, optimization, and upgrades. That includes:

• Troubleshooting and resolving technical issues across the VergeOS platform

• Managing escalations and complex customer inquiries

• Guiding customers through implementations and migrations

• Helping customers optimize their environments and follow platform best practices

• Providing technical guidance for upgrades, maintenance, and other platform changes

• Partnering with Engineering to investigate and resolve complex technical issues

• Documenting technical solutions and contributing to our internal and customer-facing knowledge base

• Identifying recurring issues and turning solutions into repeatable processes

• Using AI to research issues, analyze information, improve responses, and build more efficient support and deployment workflows

• Participating in an on-call rotation as needed

Who You Are

Successful Customer Support Engineers at Verge.io are technical problem-solvers who genuinely enjoy figuring out how things work, and why they sometimes don't.

You’re comfortable digging into Linux, virtualization, networking, logs, and infrastructure configurations to get to the root of a problem. You can work independently when needed, but you also know when to pull in Engineering or other members of the team.

You’re equally comfortable working with people. You can take a complicated technical issue and explain it clearly to a customer, keep communication moving while an issue is being resolved, and build confidence even when the answer isn't immediately obvious.

You also look beyond the individual ticket. When you solve something, you think about how we can document it, automate it, or improve the process so the next customer, and the rest of the team, benefits from what you learned.

The Experience We’re Looking For

We typically look for:

• Significant experience in technical support, infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or a similarly hands-on technical role

• Strong Linux administration skills, ideally within Debian-based environments

• Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies, including KVM/QEMU or similar platforms

• A strong understanding of networking concepts and experience troubleshooting a variety of network configurations

• Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues and working through problems methodically

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly

• Experience working directly with customers in a technical capacity

• Comfort working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment

• Practical experience using AI in your work, with examples of how it has helped you research, troubleshoot, automate, document, or work more effectively

Additional Experience That’s Valuable

• Experience in any of the following areas can be especially helpful:

• VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, or other virtualization platforms

• AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or other cloud environments

• Scripting or automation using Python, Bash, Go, or similar languages

• REST APIs and systems integrations

• GitHub projects or code samples, particularly projects

title: Harness Engineer, Director
description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO ) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
The Opportunity
As a Director, AI Harness Engineering, you will lead a new internal team that lets AI coding agents do reliable work at scale. As agents take on more of the software lifecycle, the hard part is no longer writing code - agents generate it faster than humans can review it, so the bottleneck shifts to verification and trust. Harness Engineering exists to break that bottleneck: engineering the environment that steers agents toward correct, maintainable, well-architected output so that quality is enforced by the system, not re-audited by a person on every change. We call that environment the harness (Agent = Model + Harness), and we're building a dedicated Harness Engineering team to own it. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will design and build harness components while leading and growing a regional team of harness engineers and setting the quality bar for AI-assisted engineering across the organization.

What You’ll Contribute

• Help design, build, and evolve the harness, the guides, feedback loops, guardrails, and shared context that turn raw model capability into production-grade engineering. This is a hands-on role; you will contribute to the development, not just direct it.

• Build and maintain feedforward guides (agent instruction files, reusable skills, architectural rules, reference docs, and codemods) that help agents get it right the first time and drive their adoption across teams.

• Build feedback sensors, custom linters, structural and architecture-fitness tests, verification loops, and LLM-as-judge reviewers - that catch issues automatically before they reach human reviewers.

• Own AI governance for your region: define authority boundaries for what agents may merge unaided, establish LLM testing infrastructure, and ensure AI-generated output meets quality, safety, and compliance thresholds before release.

• Define and own cross-organizational QA and quality-gating standards, ensuring consistent, enforceable engineering practices across teams and product areas.

• Run the steering loop at scale when agents repeat a class of mistake, ensure a control is engineered so it cannot happen again - and treat repository knowledge (docs, specs, context) as the system of record, fighting drift continuously.

• Decide where each control runs in the path to production, fast checks pre-commit, moreexpensive checks post-integration, and continuous sensors that scan for drift outside the changelifecycle - keeping quality as far left as is economical.

• Establish observability into agent work and own the measures that matter - cost per merged PR,time-to-merge for agent-assisted PRs, review velocity relative to PR size, defect escape rate, andagent-PR survival rate - using them to direct where the team invests next.

• Manage, coach, and grow a geographically distributed team of harness engineers; partner withstakeholders to attract talent, set goals, and measure and reward performance.

• Work closely with other engineering leaders and product management to turn specifications and acceptance criteria into enforceable controls, and to align the harness with platform and delivery roadmaps.

• Demonstrate expertise through internal enablement, presentations, and thought leadership on agent-augmented engineering.

What We’re Seeking

• Strong software engineering background with experience in large, complex codebases, and genuine care for architecture, testing, and maintainability - you remain hands-on.

• Strong consensus building skills.

• Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and a well-developed feel for where they succeed and fail.

• Experience building engineering tooling across a modern stack, linters and static analysis, CI/CD pipelines, containerized build/test enviro

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Facilities Management eXpress is currently seeking a Technical Product Manager to join our team!
Do you build things instead of writing documents about them? Do repeated manual tasks make you want to open your laptop and fix them? If AI coding tools are just how you work, keep reading.
Much of FMX ’s data starts in mechanical rooms, on rooftops, and in partner spreadsheets, and collecting it is slow and expensive. You’ll start by making our Facility Condition Assessments dramatically cheaper and faster. Then you’ll bring that approach to everywhere else data enters FMX .
You’ll be the product manager for these tools and usually the one building them, going from “huh, that’s painful” to a shipped fix in days. You’ll also spend more time on site than anyone in Product, so you’ll be our scout for the problems that never become support tickets.
As the Technical Product Manager, you will:
First priority: make the FCA operation as efficient as possible

• Own the cost and cycle time of an assessment. Baseline cost per building and square foot, technician hours, days on site, report turnaround, and rework rates, then set targets with Professional Services and report on them.

• Tackle the biggest time sinks first, across scoping, on-site capture, data cleanup, report production, and capital plan population.

• Build, ship, and support the FCA tools: the capture app and field workflow, operations tracking, the mapping and floor plan pipeline, and partner data intake.

• Get on site and do the work yourself, interviewing technicians and facilities staff and routing what you learn to the right product manager.

Broader scope: data ingestion and the cost of operations

• Cut the cost of bringing customer data into FMX during onboarding, from equipment lists and floor plans to formats nobody planned for.

• Build tooling that makes data intake repeatable instead of bespoke.

• Improve data completeness, not just speed. Thin data gathered quickly is worse than good data gathered efficiently.

• Use AI where it removes real work, like reading nameplate photos and floor plans, drafting condition narratives, and catching gaps before customers do.

• Automate internal work anywhere a small tool saves real time or money.

• When an internal tool earns a place in the FMX product, make the case and hand it off well, with documentation and data model implications.

• Keep the data defensible. Speed only counts if the work holds up.

What success looks like in year one:

• You know our cost and cycle time per assessment by heart, because you built the reporting.

• Technician hours or days per assessment are measurably down, thanks to what you shipped.

• The field team wouldn’t give up your tools, and Product makes decisions based on what you bring back.

• You’ve applied the same approach to at least one other ingestion problem, likely onboarding, and cut real cost.

Requirements
Preferred Experience & Qualities:

•
A portfolio of shipped work. This matters most. You’ve built and shipped real tools, and you can walk us through what you made, what broke, and how you fixed it.

•
Daily AI-assisted building. You use tools like Claude, Claude Code, or Cursor every day and have shipped working software with them.

•
Enough coding skill to be dangerous. You can read a stack trace, understand what an API is doing, work in git, deploy to something like Vercel, and catch the AI when it’s confidently wrong. No CS degree required.

•

title: Technical Owner

Description
TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners - people with no prior tech background - through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.
What you will do

•
Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.

•
Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.

•
Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.

•
Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.

•
Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.

•
Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.

•
Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements
Must have

•
End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.

•
Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.

•
English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

•
Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.

•
EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.

•
Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.

•
Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration

Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

Project objective

title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - English (British)
description:
About the Project 
Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. We're looking for native-level speakers who can deliver natural, everyday-sounding speech - recordings that hold up whether you're reading a script or speaking spontaneously. 
Please note: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. 
 
What You'll Do If Selected: 
Two supervised sessions of approximately 4 hours each, guided in real time by a Session Director on a separate recording platform. 
Record scripted material in a natural, conversational tone - faithfully, without a polished, performed, or “announcer” delivery. 
Record unscripted, spontaneous speech on a given topic, matching the same warmth and pace as your scripted takes. 
Set up and manage your own recording space and equipment for session recording. 
Deliver all recordings entirely in the required language (with specific dialect), without code-switching into other languages or dialects. 
 
What We're Looking For 
Required 
Experience as a voice actor, actor, or theater performer, or a comparable performance background. 
Native or native-equivalent fluency in the required language (with specific dialect). 
Access to a quiet recording space, free of echo and background noise (acoustically treated for session recording, if selected). 
Owns or will acquire a dedicated, professional-grade microphone for the audition (e.g. RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti), upgrading to a qualifying USB condenser or XLR mic + audio interface for session recording if selected. Built-in laptop mics, AirPods, earbuds, and headsets are not accepted at any stage. 
Owns closed-back monitoring headphones (required for session recording if selected). 
Comfortable both self-directing for the audition and taking live direction from a Session Director in guided sessions. 
 
Preferred (nice to have, not required) 
Professional voice-over experience (dubbing/ADR, audiobook, podcasting) in a conversational rather than commercial/announcer register. 
Baseline audio hygiene: comfortable setting mic distance and catching noise, clipping, or distortion yourself. 
An existing home recording setup already treated for sound. 
 
Your Data & Privacy 
Before any session recording, you'll be asked to review and sign a Consent Form covering how your voice recordings are collected, used (including to train synthesized/AI voice models), shared with approved partners, retained, and how to exercise your data rights (access, correction, deletion, and more, depending on where you live). If you'd like to review these terms before applying, contact us and we'll share a copy in advance.

title: AI & Innovation Lead, G&A

description:
At Sanity https://sanity.io/, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS, Figma, Riot Games, Anthropic, COMPLEX, Nordstrom, and Morning Brew use Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

In this role, you’ll join the Finance team as the AI & Innovation Lead, G&A, reporting to the CFO. You’ll sit in Finance with a dotted line to our Director of Systems Engineering. This role sits at the intersection of G&A operations, data, workflow automation, and AI. You bring the domain depth: you know how G&A teams actually work, where their processes and systems break, and which manual work eats their week. You’ll start with Finance, then quickly extend into People and the rest of G&A. You’ll prototype the fix yourself, vibe-coding agents, apps, and workflows on Sanity’s own platform and AI tools. Systems Engineering and the Data team back you on architecture, security, and production hardening, so your ideas become systems the business can rely on. If you’re a G&A operator who has already started rebuilding your own work with AI, and you want to do that for an entire G&A organization, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU WOULD DO:

- Shape and execute on the AI first transformation roadmap for G&A: map where G&A teams lose time, and decide what to build, buy, or automate first.

- Run intake, prioritization and stage-gates for the G&A transformation portfolio, with clear owners, decision rights and a regular exec review cadence

- Prototype agents, apps, and automations yourself on Sanity’s platform and AI tools, then partner with Systems Engineering to take the ones that work to production.

- Translate G&A processes into clear specs and prototypes for engineering: data flows, system of record, controls, edge cases, and what “done” looks like.

- Build for trust through controls, audit trails, access management, data quality, and human-in-the-loop review, so G&A teams and auditors can rely on what you ship.

- Partner with the Data and IT teams on the G&A systems and data infrastructure, connecting the systems G&A and our data warehouse together.

- Drive adoption across G&A: train teams, document the paved paths, and help each function run more of its own work with AI and retire legacy manual processes.

- Measure impact through hours saved, cycle times, error and exception rates, adoption, AI evals, and stakeholder feedback.

- Help shape the practices and culture of a young Systems Engineering team with a strong bias toward practical impact.

ABOUT YOU:

- Remote in North America (SF preferred).

- Deep G&A domain knowledge, ideally 8+ years in Finance, Accounting, People ops, or business operations at a software company.

- Hands-on experience applying AI to G&A work, for example leading an AI program for your function, automating a core process, or building agents for your own team.

- Comfortable building prototypes with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). You don’t need to be a software engineer, and you’re not afraid of a terminal.

- Understands APIs, data flows, and how G&A systems connect: what moves between the ERP, HRIS, CRM, contract tools, and warehouse, and where it breaks.

- Excited by AI as an operating model, including agents, tool use, structured context, prompts, evals, and automation.

- Cares deeply about controls, accuracy, auditability, and systems G&A teams can confidently rely on.

- Program management strength: you can run a cross-functional roadmap, align stakeholders, and land change with teams that are busy running the business.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and able to turn loosely defined business problems into shipped solutions.

- Clear communicator who can explain G&A processes to engineers and technical tradeoffs to G&A teams.

title: Majors Customer Success Manager
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Majors Customer Success Manager, you’ll lead AI implementation, adoption and change management for Harvey’s largest customers, including leading law firms, Fortune 500 companies and asset managers. You’ll work directly with senior leaders and practicing lawyers to identify where AI can improve their work, turn those opportunities into implementation plans and lead the cross-functional effort to deliver results.

You’ll own the customer relationship end to end as the primary lead for a portfolio of strategic accounts, from initial deployment through ongoing adoption and renewal. This role combines the strategic depth of advisory work with responsibility for account health, measurable customer value and retention. You’ll drive retention by establishing measurable value, understanding customer needs and addressing barriers to continued investment, partnering with Sales throughout the customer lifecycle.

What You’ll Do

- Lead implementation and transformation programs. Assess customer goals and current workflows, identify valuable use cases and build plans with clear milestones, owners and success measures. Drive execution across practice groups, business functions and regions, adapting the plan as you learn what works.

- Drive change in how lawyers work. Partner with lawyers and customer leadership to embed Harvey into everyday practice. Develop champions, address resistance and coordinate targeted training with Legal Product Specialists. Help customers turn successful individual use cases into repeatable ways of working across teams.

- Own your customer portfolio. Set account strategy and use adoption data, stakeholder feedback and business impact to assess progress and direct the next phase of work. Address risks early and lead the response to escalations, keeping customers informed and internal teams accountable for resolution.

- Drive retention and support growth. Conduct ongoing discovery to understand customer goals, decision criteria and stakeholder sentiment. Build the case for renewal through demonstrated value, address retention risks early and equip Sales to lead renewal discussions. Identify expansion opportunities grounded in customer needs and business impact.

- Lead cross-functional delivery. Bring together Legal Engineering, technical specialists, Product and Sales around a shared customer plan. Clarify responsibilities, manage dependencies and resolve blockers. Coordinate specialist contributions and ensure their work advances the broader account strategy. Translate customer needs and delivery lessons into product feedback and repeatable playbooks.

- Advise executives and align stakeholders. Build relationships with senior partners, General Counsel and innovation, technology and operations leaders.

As Senior Manager, Scientific Communications within Global Medical Affairs, you will support the development and execution of the global publications strategy for Empaveli across nephrology and hematology indications. (80% nephrology / 20% hematology)
You will translate scientific and medical priorities into high-quality publication plans and deliverables, working closely with cross-functional colleagues, external authors, and medical communications agencies. You will also contribute to the development of scientific platforms and ensure that publications are scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, delivered on time, and developed in accordance with Biogen standard operating procedures and industry publication standards.

What You’ll Do:

• Support the development, maintenance, and execution of global strategic publication plans for Empaveli across nephrology and hematology.

• Contribute to the development and refinement of core scientific platforms, communication objectives, and evidence-based scientific statements.

• Provide publication-related guidance to colleagues and support the development of less-experienced team members, as appropriate.

Who You Are:

You are an experienced medical affairs or scientific communications professional with strong scientific judgment and a record of successfully managing complex publication projects. You communicate clearly, work effectively across functions, and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a matrixed environment. You combine attention to scientific detail with strong project-management skills and can independently advance projects while recognizing when strategic alignment or senior-level input is needed.

• Exceptional project management abilities.

• Strong ability to work effectively in a matrix environment.

• Superior scientific acumen and communication skills.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in Nephrology and/or Hematology.

• Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional project management.

• Experience managing external vendors and overseeing project budgets.

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT CARTESIA

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Cartesia builds real-time voice and audio AI, and our customers put our models in front of their own users every day. As our Product Support Specialist, you’ll own the front line, the first person customers hear from when something is unclear, broken, or blocking them. You’re obsessed with the customer experience: you dig into every problem, don’t let go until the customer is unblocked, and treat each ticket as a chance to make Cartesia better. Our support function is still taking shape, so you’ll help shape the processes that define our post-sales support and set the standard for how customers experience Cartesia. This role is based in San Francisco.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own the support queue across Slack, Pylon, WhatsApp, and email, with extra attention to priority and enterprise accounts.

- Keep response and resolution times within SLA, so customers always know where their issue stands.

- Resolve L1 and L2 issues independently across billing, documentation, configuration, APIs, and voices.

- Troubleshoot complex L3 issues, reproduce them, gather the relevant details, and escalate to On-Call with complete context.

- Partner with Engineering and Product to turn customer issues into fixes by, writing clear bug reports and creating actionable Linear tickets, and pushing them to get prioritized when customers are blocked

- Reduce repeat tickets by building internal runbooks, improving our customer-facing documentation, and sharing what you learn about troubleshooting

- Help with incident communications by coordinating customer updates, explaining impact, and keeping customers informed on progress until resolution.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 2+ years in technical support for an API or developer product, working a live queue of customers who write code.

- Hands-on troubleshooting skills: you can read requests, responses, and logs, reproduce an issue, and tell a bug from a configuration problem.

- Clear written communication, both to customers and in bug reports, runbooks, and docs.

- Experience supporting customers in real-time channels like shared Slack channels or chat, and balancing speed with accuracy.

- A track record of working with engineers to get issues fixed, including filing well-formed tickets in a tracker like Linear.

- Comfort with ambiguity: you make good calls without a playbook, and when one is missing, you write it.

BONUS

- Experience supporting an API or developer product, where your customers write code.

- Familiarity with AI products, especially voice, speech, or audio products such as text-to-speech, speech recognition, or voice agents.

- Experience writing customer-facing updates during an incident or outage.

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

MORE DETAILS

🏢 In-office policy: We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

🌎 Visa sponsorship: We provide visa sponsorship

title: Sales Development Representative - LATAM
description:
ABOUT YOU

As Constructor.io http://Constructor.io’s Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll be crucial to driving lead generation activities for Constructor. You’ll be expected to become intimately familiar with Constructor’s product offering and key differentiators in the search space. You’re looking to contribute in an entrepreneurial environment and will enjoy access to the founders and leaders in other functional groups.

You love technology, understand Software as a Service, and are excited to take a key role in contributing to the success of a fast-growing startup. You are an excellent communicator and enjoy getting to know customers out of genuine interest and concern for their needs.

You’ll work with our outbound automation system to find leads, send emails, use Linkedin Sales Navigator, generate interest, and schedule sales calls. As the point of first contact in our sales process, you’ll be the face of Constructor to new business opportunities. You’ll qualify leads, gather as much information about the prospect as you can, and work with our sales team to close the sale. If you’re awesome, you’ll grow into an Account Executive position by taking on progressively more account responsibilities.

 

ABOUT US

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

- Take ownership of building top-of-funnel sales opportunities for the sales team by sourcing and qualifying business prospects.

- Manage a high volume of activity, including emails, Linkedin Sales Navigator, and calls, with the ultimate goal to set meetings with qualified customers to discuss our services.

- Critically evaluate our sales process and service to give us feedback on what resonates with customers and what doesn't.

- Collaborate closely with the rest of the sales team to ensure success down-funnel and better inform lead generation activities based on deals won and lost.

- Experiment and iterate to create high-converting, personalized customer introductions explaining our services.

- Manage sales lead data in Salesforce to provide visibility to optimize lead generation activities.

REQUIREMENTS

- 1-2 years experience in sales or sales development.

- A proven track record of sales success at tech companies, large or small.

- A true passion for the products we're building, including good working knowledge of APIs, data, and web technology.

- Basic comfort working with sales tools (e.g. Salesforce and high-end email automation toolsets).

- Fluent in Spanish and / or Portuguese

BENEFITS

title: Senior Product Developer
description:
✨ About the Company
Makeship empowers influencers, creators, and brands of all sizes to develop and launch limited-edition products that matter to their fans. Leveraging our design, manufacturing, and marketing expertise, we work with our partners to bring their products to life through our community-powered crowdfunding platform. Each product is given a window of 21 days to be funded by the community before we produce and ship to fans worldwide. We put our brand behind every product and guarantee quality and ethical sourcing.
We're profitable; we have a three-year revenue growth of over 200%, ranking us 97th in 2024 and 86th on The Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies of 2025 list. We are also excited to announce that Makeship has officially been Great Place to Work-Certified™ for 3 years in a row! Learn more about us at Makeship .com.
🧑‍💻 About the Role
During this exciting phase of our growth, you’ll play a huge role in shaping our culture, our process, and the future of Makeship . Every day, you’ll collaborate, learn more about the content creation space, and watch your work impact the company and the community!
We want this to be the best work experience of your life, so we’ll pay you well, offer great benefits, invest deeply in your growth, and welcome you with our branded swag. You will also be joining one of Canada's fastest-growing start-ups!
🌟 What We Are Looking For
We are looking for a Senior Product Developer who’ll take physical product concepts from initial ideas through research, design, and development to a successful launch - working across a wide variety of product categories. We are looking for a highly organized, collaborative product development professional with strong project management skills who thrives owning multiple product initiatives at once, from concept through production. As a Senior Product Developer, you'll work hands-on with cross-functional teams and manufacturing partners, solve real production challenges, and bring a wide range of product ideas across Makeship 's product categories to life.
🚀 Your Key Responsibilities
Product Ideation & Design Partnership

• Partner with Design from the earliest ideation, bringing material, construction, and factory knowledge to the table and contributing to brainstorming to ensure concepts are both creatively strong and production feasible.

Project & Process Management

• Take full ownership of assigned product lines, managing multiple development initiatives simultaneously with strong organization and follow-through.

• Own project timelines end-to-end, proactively identifying risks and blockers and adjusting plans to keep products on track for launch.

• Maintain clear, organized documentation across projects (specs, samples, approvals, revisions) so status is easy to track at any point.

• Continuously look for ways to streamline and improve the product development process.

Manufacturing & Quality

• Collaborate with manufacturing partners and vendors to develop, test, and approve samples through to bulk production

• Ensure all products meets Makeship ’s quality, safety, and cost standards at the appropriate checkpoin

title: Senior Counsel, Commercial (Health and Life Sciences)
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Legal team plays a crucial role in advancing our mission by tackling innovative and fundamental legal issues in AI. The team includes professionals from diverse legal fields - technology, AI, infrastructure, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation - who collaborate closely with colleagues across the company.

If you are passionate about being a technology lawyer working on cutting-edge challenges, you’ll thrive here.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced attorney to join our commercial legal team. Based in the US, you will help lead commercial legal support for OpenAI’s rapidly growing business, working with teams such as GTM, Partnerships, Procurement, Finance, Product, Infrastructure, and Engineering.

This is a great opportunity to join OpenAI’s commercial legal team, negotiating high-impact agreements and helping to build scalable frameworks for responsible growth.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, where we follow a hybrid schedule of 3 days in the office per week. Remote candidates will also be considered, and we offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Serve as the legal partner for OpenAI’s business transactions, partnerships, and operations, with a focus on life sciences.

- Provide practical, business-oriented legal advice to teams including Go-to-Market, Partnerships, and Research.

- Draft, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements with enterprise customers, vendors, and strategic partners, including transactions involving life sciences.

- Identify and coordinate issues involving intellectual property, privacy, security, regulatory requirements, and product use with the appropriate specialist teams.

- Lead negotiations and manage multiple stakeholders, escalating consequential issues with clear options and recommendations.

- Develop and improve templates, playbooks, processes, and training that make routine contracting more efficient and consistent.

- Monitor and advise on regulatory and compliance matters affecting AI and technology in life sciences.

- Collaborate with colleagues across OpenAI’s global legal team to ensure alignment across jurisdictions.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 10+ years of relevant legal experience, including substantial responsibility for drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements.

- Have experience with life sciences transactions.

- Are familiar with HIPAA and transactions involving health data.

- Can translate legal and commercial complexity into clear, actionable advice for business stakeholders and senior leaders.

- Exercise sound judgment, take ownership, and move matters forward when facts are incomplete or circumstances change.

- Build trust across functions and can communicate a principled position while working constructively toward a solution.

- Enjoy improving processes and creating practical tools that help a growing team scale.

- Are curious about technology and motivated to learn about AI and its commercial implications.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.opena

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

Atlas is the founding engineering team responsible for the Maps mandate at Verkada. Our mission is to transform the physical world into a high-performance, interactive digital twin. Maps launches its private beta today.

The Platform Mandate

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. - Design, develop, and deploy an assigned Cards or Issuing project under mentor guidance.

- Buddy assignment: Pair with a senior engineer/mentor for end-to-end feature lifecycle walkthrough, and weekly technical check-ins.

- Tools orientation: Setup access to relevant AI and development tools

- Domain familiarization: Walkthrough of identified finance operational workflows (e.g., cash reconciliation, PO approvals) with relevant domain experts

Proposed schedule of Review Check-ins:

- Monthly check-in for progress review and feedback sharing

- Able to commit to a 6 month placement period, ideally commence in Jan ‘27 through to June 2027.

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like - and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds - which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE AND YOU

We're hiring a Demand Generation Lead to own pipeline generation for North America. Today, demand gen at Lorikeet is spread across several people who each carry a piece of it alongside their day jobs - this role exists to change that. You'll be the first person whose sole focus is building the machine that fills our pipeline.

You'll own a North American pipeline target and work backwards from it - designing and executing the mix of events, webinars, industry programs, and campaigns that gets us there. You'll also help shape how demand gen scales as a function as we grow, defining the playbook rather than inheriting one. This is a mid-senior role for someone who's comfortable being accountable to a hard revenue-linked number with a high degree of autonomy over how they hit it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the North American pipeline target and build the quarterly plan that gets us there

- Design and run the full demand gen program mix: field events, executive dinners, webinars, industry programs, and integrated campaigns

- Work backwards from pipeline goals to channel-level targets, budgets, and forecasts, and report clearly on what's working and what isn't

- Partner closely with Sales to ensure every program converts - tight handoffs, fast follow-up, and shared accountability for pipeline quality

- Build the demand gen operating infrastructure from scratch: campaign tracking, attribution, and reporting that give us a real view of the funnel

- Identify which channels and plays are worth scaling and which to kill, iterating quickly with limited resources

- Define the demand gen playbook for Lorikeet as we grow, laying the foundation for the function's future team and budget

THE RIGHT CANDIDATE

We're looking for someone who is energized by owning a number, not just running programs - someone who sees a pipeline target as a puzzle to reverse-engineer rather than a burden. The ideal candidate learned the fundamentals of demand gen inside a rigorous, well-resourced marketing org, then proved they could build the whole thing from scratch with none of that scaffolding.

You might be a fit if you:

- Have 4-7 years of demand generation experience in B2B SaaS

- Have early-stage startup (under ~100 people) experience, building the demand gen function from zero - choosing channels, setting up systems, and owning outcomes without a big team or budget

- Have hands-on experience across the program mix: field events, webinars, executive dinners, and industry programs, not just digital campaigns

- Think in pipeline, not MQLs - you work backwards from revenue targets and can defend your math

- Operate with high autonomy and low need for direction, and are relentless about follow-through

- Care about the quality of the pipeline you create, not just the volume - you see Sales as you

title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect.<

title: Python Finance Developer (100% Remote)
description:
About UBQ.io
UBQ.io is a global technology service provider dedicated to building a more sustainable, independent, and equitable future. We partner with global companies across industries, including AI, blockchain, software, biotech, and education, to transform bold ideas into real, meaningful solutions.
Our expertise spans technology consulting, AI and Machine Learning development, Blockchain integration, and global team collaboration. With a worldwide network of specialists, we help organizations stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.
At UBQ.io, we don’t just advise, we collaborate. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and social responsibility guides everything we do as we help clients build technologies that empower people, communities, and industries to thrive.
About the role
We are looking for a Finance Developer to join our team and help build an internal web platform that supports portfolio management for our finance and operations teams. Working at the intersection of
finance and technology, you will turn financial data and business requirements into accurate, reliable tools. You will own features from end to end, from data queries and calculation logic through to the user interface.
What you'll do

• Design, build and maintain platform features, including summary metrics, interactive tables and data visualisations.

Advantageous

• Front-end experience with React and TypeScript, especially data-heavy UIs.

• A background in asset management, fund administration, treasury or fintech.
